functionalReqs: Locks expire if the holder dies (leases)
Fencing tokens to protect downstream writes
hints: What happens if a client pauses (GC) longer than the TTL and then writes?
Unlock must only release a lock you own. How do you check-and-delete atomically?

DistributedLock interface; LockBackend (RedisBackend with SET NX PX + Lua compare-and-delete, ZookeeperBackend with ephemeral sequential nodes); owner ID per client+thread; LeaseRenewer background thread; monotonically increasing fencing token returned on acquire.
nonFunctionalReqs: Safety: two clients never believe they hold the same lock
problemStatement: Design a **distributed lock client library** that services use to ensure only one instance performs a critical section at a time, backed by a pluggable store (Redis, ZooKeeper, a database).
